all.label: trains at least twice a week
has a goal that extra protein supports

timing.note: Total daily intake dominates; the post-workout window is far less important than the meta-analytic evidence is often used to suggest. The routine builder may therefore schedule freely around the user's day.

review.note: Target band is ISSN policy, NOT the ICMR-NIN population requirement (0.83 g/kg/day) in reference/. Two different kinds of number, deliberately kept in different layers. Worked example: 72 kg x 1.8 = 130 g/day target, minus ~90 g from food = 40 g gap; at 24 g per scoop that is 1.67 servings, which rounds to 1.5.
